_meta.purpose: Forward-use pattern library, NOT a backtest. Machine-readable companion to FRAUD_CASE_LIBRARY.md.
_meta.epistemic_note: Built from trained knowledge of well-documented public cases; no live WebSearch/WebFetch verification pass was run. Figures marked confidence='approximate' are widely-reported estimates, not verified from primary source in this pass. Do not use for any real-money or reputational claim without a source-verification pass.

cases.name: Satyam Computer Services
cases.status_note: Raju confession 7-Jan-2009 public record; CBI special court conviction 2015 (appeals adjusted some sentences); SEBI 2018 order vs auditors litigated.
cases.mo: Fictitious sales invoices, forged FD receipts/bank statements, fabricated interest income, understated liabilities, sustained for years.
cases.lesson: Self-dealing acquisition attempt was the biggest tell, not the accounting ratios.

cases.name: Gitanjali Gems / Mehul Choksi (PNB LoU fraud)
cases.status_note: Choksi declared fugitive economic offender; extradition litigation ongoing; Indian criminal trial pending.
cases.mo: Fraudulent LoUs issued without collateral/CBS entry, drew unsecured buyer's credit from other banks' overseas branches, ~Rs 11,000-14,000cr combined exposure (approximate, contested).
outside_equity_scope: SWIFT-core-banking-system reconciliation gap (bank-side control failure, not borrower filing)
cases.lesson: Some fraud enablers live in counterparty/bank control failures no borrower-side ratio analysis would surface.

cases.name: Yes Bank / Rana Kapoor
cases.status_note: RBI moratorium/reconstruction (Mar-2020) settled fact; Kapoor ED arrest/chargesheet in DHFL-linked case, criminal trial ongoing.
cases.mo: Alleged loan evergreening; alleged kickbacks via Kapoor-family entities for loan sanctions to stressed borrowers (incl. DHFL); understated NPAs vs RBI divergence; rapid AT-1 issuance.
cases.gap_note: RBI divergence reports / large-exposure disclosures not currently ingested by ALPHA_RANKER.
cases.lesson: Bank-disclosed NPA-divergence (RBI-mandated since 2018) is a rare structured red flag hiding in plain sight.

cases.name: DHFL (Dewan Housing Finance, Wadhawan brothers)
cases.status_note: CBI/ED chargesheet 2022, ~Rs 34,000cr (approximate, widely reported); NCLT resolution to Piramal Capital (2021) settled; trial outcome unknown.
cases.mo: Loans to ~80 shell/related entities sharing addresses with promoter entities; alleged parallel 'Bandra Book' unrecorded loan book (~Rs 14,000cr alleged); securitization gains booked upfront.
cases.lesson: Shell-company lending footprint is address-overlap between borrower and promoter entities, an MCA/ROC filing-read task.

cases.name: IL&FS (Infrastructure Leasing & Financial Services)
cases.status_note: NCLT board supersession Oct-2018; SFIO chargesheets vs former execs; final adjudication outcomes unknown.
cases.mo: 300+ subsidiary/SPV group structure rolling over debt, related-party ICDs between group entities, asset-liability duration mismatch, AAA rating held until days before default.
cases.gap_note: Group-structure/ICD-volume not ingested; rating trajectory not ingested.
cases.lesson: AAA-to-D in months proves ratings are lagging; group ICD web is the true leading indicator and lives in AR footnotes.

cases.name: Manpasand Beverages
cases.status_note: Deloitte resigned May-2018 citing fake-sales/GST-invoice concerns (public exchange filing); SFIO/EOW chargesheet vs promoter; trial outcome unknown.
cases.mo: Fake sales via fictitious/related distributors to inflate revenue and claim fraudulent GST input-tax-credit; channel stuffing.
cases.gap_note: CONFIRMED GAP: auditor-change/resignation event not currently a computed flag in universe_forensic.py despite being 08's own hard-veto item #1. Highest-priority fix.
cases.lesson: Auditor resignation-for-cause is the cheapest, hardest, least-noisy hard-veto signal in the taxonomy -- and is currently unimplemented.

cases.name: Vakrangee Ltd
cases.status_note: SEBI 2018 interim restraining orders; SAT later granted relief diluting parts of the order. No settled adjudication of guilt.
cases.mo: Alleged circular trading supporting share price; exaggerated/unverified business-partnership claims (disputed Amazon-India tie-up characterization); ~70%+ single-day crash Jan-2018.
cases.lesson: An unverifiable third-party partnership claim underlying a valuation narrative is itself the red flag, independent of ratios.

cases.name: PC Jeweller
cases.status_note: Some lenders NPA/fraud-classified accounts 2020-21; ED provisional attachment reported; SFIO probe reported; no final adjudication known; ongoing/unresolved.
cases.mo: Alleged circular transactions between related entities; alleged gold/diamond inventory mismatch vs physical verification; high related-sundry-debtor receivables; alleged buyer's-credit misuse.
cases.lesson: 'Profitable on paper, cannot pay debt' is the strongest cross-sector tell in this library; CFO/PAT divergence is the right first-pass screen.

cases.name: Cox & Kings
cases.status_note: SFIO/ED investigation into Kerkar family; chargesheets reported filed; trial outcome unknown. CP/NCD default Sept-2019 is settled market fact.
cases.mo: Alleged siphoning via related-party forex/travel-card financial-services subsidiary; unsecured CP funding that subsidiary; default despite reported strong cash.
cases.lesson: Reported cash is not verified cash; large-cash-then-sudden-default is a textbook match for 08's own named §B flag, currently under-weighted.

cases.name: Zee Entertainment / Essel Group (Subhash Chandra)
cases.status_note: SEBI 2022 interim order (~Rs 200cr alleged, approximate) stayed/modified on SAT appeal; Goenka reinstated on interim relief. Jan-2019 pledge invocation is a settled market event, not itself adjudicated fraud.
cases.mo: Essel promoter entities borrowed via ICDs from MFs pledging Zee shares for group infra/EPC stress; separately alleged fund diversion to shell entities.
cases.gap_note: CONFIRMED GAP: promoter pledge, zero coverage in ALPHA_RANKER (universe_forensic.py explicit insufficient-data hook).
cases.lesson: Promoter pledge is a top-tier recurring flag ALPHA_RANKER currently cannot compute at all -- highest-value data gap in this library.

cases.name: Ricoh India
cases.status_note: SEBI 2020 order found erstwhile management complicit; FY2015-16 accounts formally restated profit-to-loss (settled fact); some individual appeals contested, final outcomes not fully verified.
cases.mo: Revenue on fictitious sale-and-leaseback/operating-lease transactions without genuine underlying assets/customers; inflated receivables tied to fictitious leases.
cases.lesson: A sudden shift in WHAT KIND of revenue a company books (not just how much) is a screenable business-model-mix anomaly.

cases.name: Amtek Auto
cases.status_note: Primarily a leverage/governance collapse (JM Financial MF redemption gating 2015); IBC resolution protracted; no major adjudicated fraud conviction known to me. 'Fraud' framing here is allegation, not adjudication.
cases.mo: Aggressive debt-funded global M&A; related-party corporate guarantees/inter-group loans obscuring consolidated leverage; rating held high until sudden multi-notch downgrade.
cases.gap_note: Rating-history ingestion missing -- THIRD case (with IL&FS, DHFL) pointing at same gap.
cases.lesson: Credit-rating-history ingestion gap has recurred across three independent cases -- a pattern, not a coincidence.

cases.name: Kingfisher Airlines / Vijay Mallya
cases.status_note: FEOA fugitive-economic-offender declaration (2019, civil-forfeiture-style, not criminal conviction); UK extradition ordered/upheld, delayed by other proceedings; some IDBI officials separately implicated in related case (unverified specifics); Mallya's own criminal trial outcome in India unresolved/unknown.
cases.mo: Alleged inadequately-diligenced IDBI loan (~Rs 900cr approximate) allegedly diverted outside sanctioned purpose incl. to other UB Group entities; continued borrowing/CDR restructuring despite worsening financials; personal guarantees not honored.
cases.lesson: Multi-year negative-CFO-funded-by-fresh-debt was visible years before collapse; detection existed, enforcement didn't -- itself the lesson.

cases.name: Educomp Solutions
cases.status_note: Default and insolvency settled facts; auditor qualifications documented; no marquee criminal fraud conviction of promoters known to me as final. 'Fraud' framing is allegation/aggressive-accounting, not adjudication.
cases.mo: Upfront revenue recognition on multi-year 'Smart Class' annuity contracts (full value at signing, not over service period); receivables ballooned vs collections; promoter pledge near 100%; serial QIP dilution.
cases.gap_note: Pledge gap -- FOURTH case (with Zee, PC Jeweller, Vakrangee) pointing at same missing pledge dataset.
cases.lesson: Promoter pledge near 100% recurs in 4/15 cases and is entirely missing from ALPHA_RANKER's current data -- near hard-veto grade.

cases.name: Karvy Stock Broking
cases.status_note: SEBI 2019 orders + NSE corroboration found client-securities misuse via PoA; Karvy barred from new broking clients; some findings later contested/modified before SAT, final disposition unverified.
cases.mo: Client securities pooled via PoA into single demat account, pledged to raise loans (~Rs 2,300cr approximate) diverted to promoter's unrelated real-estate arm (Karvy Realty).
outside_equity_scope: depository (NSDL/CDSL) account-level reconciliation; unlisted-entity (Karvy Realty) not in listed-equity universe at all
cases.lesson: Worst frauds are sometimes custodian/intermediary control failures invisible to any equity-fundamentals screen -- needs a different data source category entirely.

top_5_recurring_patterns.pattern: Opaque group structure / related-party ICD web obscuring leverage and cash location

outside_current_taxonomy_frame.pattern: Intermediary/custodian control failures (bank SWIFT-CBS gap, broker PoA-commingling)
outside_current_taxonomy_frame.note: Invisible to any equity-fundamentals screen; needs a different data source category (banking/depository-audit disclosures).

outside_current_taxonomy_frame.pattern: Business-model-mix anomaly (sudden revenue/debt in a line unrelated to stated core business)
outside_current_taxonomy_frame.note: Detectable from revenue/debt-mix trend, not currently a named flag category in 08_FORENSICS_REDFLAGS.md.
